page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.hfc6.8xlarge is a compute-optimized virtual server instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 32 dedicated physical cores on an Intel Xeon 8269CY processor with an x86_64 architecture, operating at a clock speed of 3.1 GHz. The instance is configured with 64.0 GB of system memory, yielding a 2.0 GB per core ratio. It does not include local storage or GPU accelerators, but provides a baseline network bandwidth of 10 Gbps.

Benchmark results place this instance in the middle 50% tier across multiple workloads. The Intel Xeon processor delivers a single-core stress-ng score of 1435.39 and a multi-core score of 30631.79, supported by AVX-512 vector extensions. Memory performance shows a read-only small block cached bandwidth of 1704.01 GB/s, which drops to 104.96 GB/s for large uncached blocks. In application-specific tests, the server achieves a Redis SET throughput of 29.05 million operations per second and a static web serving throughput of 20.59 GB/s.

With its 1:2 vCPU-to-RAM ratio, the ecs.hfc6.8xlarge offers a cost-efficient profile for compute-heavy workloads that do not require massive memory footprints or local storage. The dedicated core allocation ensures consistent performance without resource contention. This configuration is suitable for high-throughput web serving, software compilation, database operations, and moderate-sized language model inference tasks.
